name: Qdrant Cloud Inference
description: Vector database with hosted embedding and reranking inference.
overview: Qdrant Cloud bundles managed embedding and reranking models with its free vector-database tier, so you can embed and rerank without an extra vendor. Inference-specific retention boundaries are only partly documented, and free hosted models run in the United States.
free_access: Runs alongside a free 1 GB cluster
notes: Free clusters and inference run in the US region.
